checked_claims: Resolved prior lap-count finding: Setup line 38 directs players to use the lap count printed on the selected board, matching source lines 117-121 and 356-358. Its optional one-lap first USA learning race and normal two-lap USA race match source lines 70-73.

Resolved prior Stress-reserve finding: Setup line 44 places remaining Stress cards face up near the board as a reserve, matching source line 89 and supporting the spin-out additions at source lines 281-289.

Compared the final snapshot to the prior snapshot: only the two source-supported setup additions and consequent setup numbering changed. Reread the complete final snapshot against the complete extracted core rulebook; no new material contradictions or important missing core rules found.
Components and normal setup quantities match lines 38-53 and 70-94; the source itself uses 6 Heat and 3 Stress as its typical setup example.
Steps 1 and 2 are simultaneous and ordered; everyone completes them before individual turns. Each player then completes steps 3-9 before the next begins (106-121, 142-161, 301-308).
A two-position shift costs 1 Heat immediately during Shift Gears; Heat costs move Engine cards to discard (147-149, 333-346).

Cards played equal the gear, and movement uses total revealed speed. Cars can be passed; a full destination forces placement in the nearest available space behind it. Race Line position breaks side-by-side ties (150-155, 174-188).

Every played Stress resolves before Adrenaline. Flipped non-Speed cards are immediately discarded; the found Speed card goes atop the played Stress in the Play Area, so both remain until Replenish (189-207, 229-235, 305-306).

Adrenaline applies to the last car, or last two in a race starting with at least five cars. It grants access to 1 Cooldown and optional +1 speed during React, before or after Boost; it cannot be saved. Starting field size continues to apply after finishers leave (209-218, 366-371).

React symbols may be used in any order, supporting Cooldown from hand into Engine followed by payment of that Heat for Boost. First and second gear grant Cooldown 3 and 1 respectively (219-248, 333-336).
Boost is optional, at most once per turn, costs 1 available Engine Heat, uses the Stress flip procedure, and increases corner-check speed (249-258, 333-338).

Slipstream is optional when next to or immediately behind another car and moves 2 spaces without increasing corner-check speed. Any Corner Line crossed still triggers the ordinary corner check (259-280).

Every crossed corner is checked in crossing order against total speed for the round, separately paying excess Heat. This supports including Boost and Adrenaline and excluding Slipstream in the same total used at every corner (213-217, 257-280).
An unaffordable corner costs all remaining Engine Heat, returns the car before that corner, adds Stress directly to hand based on gear, and resets to first gear (281-289, 333-338).
Optional hand discards prohibit Stress and Heat; discard piles cannot be browsed and only their top cards are public. Replenish discards the Play Area and draws only back up to seven (290-308).
Running out of the draw deck interrupts any draw or flip to reshuffle the discard, without including cards still in the Play Area (309-316).

Heat normally cycles Engine to discard to deck to hand and returns to Engine through Cooldown. The explicit cluttered-hand rule overrides the normal prohibition on playing or discarding Heat: commit all playable cards, cover the difference with Heat, do not move, reset to first gear, discard the Play Area, and skip directly to Replenish (320-355).

Final-round finishing order uses distance ahead and then Race Line position. A final-lap finish cannot be crossed by Slipstream, and Slipstream is unavailable after crossing. Post-finish corner limits are ignored; finishers leave only at round end, and racing continues for the rest (356-371).
